evidence.note: PACE runs a reasoning LLM's thinking for the next robot action concurrently with the current action's physical execution, and sizes each step's thinking-token budget to fit the execution window, evaluated in the Robotouille kitchen-planning simulator with Qwen3-8B-AWQ.
evidence.title: PACE: Adaptive Budget Allocation for Time-Efficient Embodied Planning
